permission.title: Bring your calendar events into Aido

facts.sources: Works with the iCloud, Google, and Outlook calendars on this device
facts.read: Aido saves only the title, date, and time of the events you choose, as to-dos
facts.noAccountInfo: Your calendar account details, like your email, are never sent to Aido
facts.oneTime: It copies your events once. Your calendar stays exactly as it is
facts.optional: Everything else works even if you don't allow access

permission.deniedDescription: Turn on calendar access in Settings to import events
permission.deniedDescriptionMac: On your Mac, turn on Aido in System Settings > Privacy & Security > Calendars

range.title: Date range
range.freeUntil_one: The free plan imports events for the next {{count}} day (through {{date}}).
range.freeUntil_other: The free plan imports events for the next {{count}} days (through {{date}}).
range.freeUntilPremium: Go Premium for events further ahead

calendars.title: Choose calendars to import
calendars.description: Holiday, birthday, and subscribed calendars are unchecked. Pick them if you need them
calendars.emptyTitle: No events to import in this range
calendars.emptyDescription: Try a longer range, or check that your calendar app has events
calendars.tooMany: You can import up to {{limit}} events at once. Choose a shorter range or fewer calendars

missingHelp.title: Missing a calendar?
missingHelp.description: Aido can import only the calendars shown in this device's calendar app. If a calendar lives only in another app, add that account to this device

iphone.openAppsSettings: Open iPhone Settings > Apps > Calendar > Calendar Accounts

ipad.openAppsSettings: Open iPad Settings > Apps > Calendar > Calendar Accounts

ios.addAccount: Tap Add Account, add your Google or Outlook account, and turn on Calendars

mac.openSettings: On your Mac, open System Settings > Internet Accounts
mac.addAccount: Add your Google or Outlook account and turn on Calendars

android.addAccount: Open Settings > Accounts and add your Google or Outlook account
android.turnOnSync: In your calendar app, turn on and sync that account's calendars

missingHelp.comeBack: Come back to Aido and it shows up in the list

categories.title: Which category should they go in?
categories.description: Choose a category for each calendar's to-dos
categories.noSlots: Your categories are full, so you can't create new ones. Choose an existing category
categories.newCategoryLocked: New category '{{name}}' · You can't create more categories

rejected.capacity: This category can only take {{count}} of {{expected}}. Choose a shorter range or another category
rejected.nameTaken: A category with this name already exists. Rename it or choose that category
rejected.notFound: This category was deleted. Choose another one
rejected.summary: Some categories can't be used. Choose another category for the marked calendars

options.title: One last check
options.includeTimeDescription: When off, only dates come in, so you won't get time reminders
options.shareWithFriendsDescription: When off, only you can see them
options.disclosure: When you tap Import, the title, date, and time of the events you chose are saved to Aido as to-dos

progress.leaveNotice: You can leave the app. The import keeps going
progress.offline: The import continues when you're back online
progress.paused: Paused for now. It continues when you reopen the app
progress.notOnThisDevice: Another device is importing this. Finish it there or stop it here
progress.cancelConfirmDescription: Events that aren't to-dos yet won't be imported

failure.tooManyItems: You can import up to {{limit}} events at once. Choose a shorter range or fewer calendars and try again
failure.invalid: We couldn't read the range or events. Change the range and try again
failure.rejected: Aido couldn't receive the events. Try again in a moment

counts.skippedInvalid: Couldn't read the date or title

result.undoNotice: You can undo this within 7 days. Completed to-dos stay
result.duplicateNotice: Importing the same events again won't add them twice
result.undoConfirmDescription: Only to-dos you haven't completed are removed
result.failedDescription: To-dos already created stay. Import again to continue
result.alreadyImportedTitle: These events are already in Aido

toasts.startFailed: Couldn't start the import. Please try again
toasts.cancelFailed: Couldn't stop the import. Please try again
toasts.undoFailed: Couldn't undo the import. Please try again
toasts.permissionRequestFailed: Couldn't ask for calendar access. Please try again
toasts.rangeAdjusted: It's past midnight, so the range now starts today
